title: Minister Joe's special-needs youth group talks about the Hill

tellings.quote: he was saying that some of his uh kids in his youth group were talking about the hill

plain: In 2023 a minister named Joe, who runs a youth group for children with special needs at a large church, said some of the children in his group were talking about "the hill." The documentary filmmaker Ky Dickens, who made a film about children who seem to read minds, repeats what the minister told her. She tells it because it suggests the children share an experience that nobody taught them.
